name: Human Warrior 4
body:
A harrowed old man driven on by a cruel spirit haunting him. He carries on with determination but no spark of recognition in his eye.

Human Warrior 4
CR 2

XP 600
Male old human warrior 4
NE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 10 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 34 (4d10+8)
Fort +4, Ref +2, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee war razor +5 (1d4+1/18-20) or unarmed strike +5 (1d3+1)

TACTICS

During Combat Whether he’s being influenced by a spirit or not, he fights tenaciously, slashing at foes with his war razor or punching if unarmed. Somewhat of a misogynist, he focuses his attacks on women first, particularly those who seem to him to be attempting to “be men” (heavily armored women or those wielding two-handed weapons).

Morale While under the spirit’s influence, he fights to the death; otherwise he flees or surrenders if reduced to fewer than 12 hit points.

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 13, Con 11, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +5; CMD 17
Feats Dodge, Improved Unarmed Strike, Toughness
Skills Intimidate +7, Knowledge (local) +9, Perception +5, Sense Motive +5, Stealth +5
Languages Common, Dwarven, +1 additional
Gear war razor, waterskin
